answer.rationale: Cannot meet an 18% spend cut by staying with the incumbent after finance confirmed they won't reopen pricing this cycle. The low-cost vendor's standalone quote already satisfies the mandate, and memory_c6 shows multi-year terms with the incumbent only moved unit cost — not relevant here since incumbent has refused. The 14-day expiry and lack of auto-renew make deferral unsafe; running at 94% of committed volume with no buffer means a stockout is the worst possible outcome. Decision: switch_primary_vendor to the low-cost vendor, leveraging the c2 precedent that onboarding was quick and invoicing remained accurate last cycle. If verification confirms c2 holds, proceed without a guarded test; if any reliability flag emerges, run a small guarded test ramp before full cutover. Negotiation is foreclosed by the incumbent's position, and adding a second source does not solve the cost mandate on its own.
